description.p: Younblock runs a tiny local proxy with secure DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS) and TLS fragmentation, then points the system proxy at it, so YouTube loads and plays when a network blocks or throttles it.

One static binary with the whole UI built in; nothing to configure and it works with every mainstream browser. This Flatpak keeps its settings inside its own sandbox; the .deb and AppImage editions share ~/.config/Younblock.
Linux packages (.deb, AppImage and Flatpak) built from the same source tree, and start-with-OS entries that name the right launcher for each edition.
The same app for everyone: 64-bit and 32-bit Windows, and the Linux single-executable edition with the browser control page.
